# Zanzavat Bahuudeshiya Shaikshanik Sanstha

> A registered non-governmental organization (NGO) based in Nagpur, Maharashtra, India, dedicated to grassroots child education, free healthcare camps, relief distribution, and community empowerment.

## Organization Summary
- **Legal Name:** Zanzavat Bahuudeshiya Shaikshanik Sanstha
- **Common Names:** Zanzavat Sanstha, झंझावात बहुउद्देशीय शैक्षणिक संस्था
- **Location:** Nagpur, Maharashtra, India
- **Mission:** Empowering underserved children and rural communities through accessible education, preventive healthcare, and essential welfare supplies.
- **Official Website:** https://www.zanzavatsanstha.in
- **Contact Phone:** +91 93225 52882
- **Contact Email:** zanzavatsanstha@gmail.com
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/zanzavat_sanstha

## Core Initiatives & Programs
- **Educating India For India:** Providing school bags, notebooks, stationery kits, and learning support to underprivileged children in rural and slum areas.
- **Wellness for Every Indian:** Free primary health screenings, pediatric checks, eye examinations, and distribution of essential medicines.
- **Relief & Distribution Drives:** Distribution of dry grocery ration kits to daily-wage families, cooked meal drives, and winter blanket distributions.
- **Checkmate Championship:** Annual youth chess tournament organized in Vidarbha to nurture strategic skills and fundraise for community causes.
